def pullback [Preorder P] {p q : P} (_h : p ≤ q) (S : Sieve p) : Sieve q where
    carrier := {r | r ∈ S.carrier ∧ q ≤ r}
    bounded  := fun ⟨_, hr⟩ => hr
    upward_closed := fun ⟨r'_in_S, q_le_r' ⟩ r'_le_r => ⟨S.upward_closed r'_in_S r'_le_r, le_trans q_le_r' r'_le_r⟩
